name: JoAi: Cancel Subscription

description.en: Cancel an active subscription. The customer keeps access until the current billing period ends.
description.de: Kündige ein aktives Abonnement. Der Kunde behält den Zugang bis zum Ende des aktuellen Abrechnungszeitraums.
description.fr: Annulez un abonnement actif. Le client conserve l'accès jusqu'à la fin de la période de facturation en cours.
description.es: Cancela una suscripción activa. El cliente mantiene el acceso hasta el final del periodo de facturación actual.
description.it: Annulla un abbonamento attivo. Il cliente mantiene l'accesso fino alla fine del periodo di fatturazione corrente.
description.ro: Anulează un abonament activ. Clientul păstrează accesul până la sfârșitul perioadei de facturare curente.

bot: Use when the user wants to cancel a subscription. If they refer to a subscription by customer or product, list subscriptions first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Subscription ID

description.en: The hashid of the subscription to cancel
description.de: Die Hashid des zu kündigenden Abonnements
description.fr: Le hashid de l'abonnement à annuler
description.es: El hashid de la suscripción a cancelar

inputs.bot: The subscription hash ID. If the user refers to a subscription by customer or product, list subscriptions first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.fr: Slug d'équipe pour cette action. Par défaut l'équipe actuelle.
description.es: Slug del equipo para esta acción. Por defecto el equipo actual.
description.it: Slug del team per questa azione. Predefinito: team attuale.
description.ro: Slug-ul echipei pentru această acțiune. Implicit echipa curentă.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
